source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This model can carry 5 **HERNKYN YAEGIR** models.

As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, you may pick 1 **HERNKYN YAEGIR** unit in your army that was never split before and split it into two units:

- Make the two halves as equal in model count as possible, and note which models form each.
- One half must begin the battle embarked in this **TRANSPORT**.
- The other half may begin embarked in another **TRANSPORT** or be set up on its own.

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
